# Franchise Architect: Football

Franchise Architect: Football is a proprietary browser franchise simulator by VaultSpark Studios LLC.

Canonical URL: https://playfranchisearchitect.com/
Contact: football@playfranchisearchitect.com
Rights: Proprietary - All Rights Reserved, VaultSpark Studios LLC.

Useful paths:
- / - browser game
- /simulation.html - what the football simulation is measured against, and the stated limits of that anchor
- /about.html - about the game, what is being built next, and the FAQ
- /press.html - press kit: boilerplate, fact sheet, logo, mark, cover image
- /status.html - dated release notes (newest); /status-archive.html carries every note
- /contact.html - project contact
- /privacy.html - privacy notice
- /terms.html - terms and rights notice
- /agents.json - machine-readable agent metadata
- /stats.html - human-readable near-live Community Stats Atlas
- https://api-franchise-architect-football.vaultsparkstudios.com/community/v1/snapshot - machine-readable aggregate snapshot
- /stats-surface.json - stats contract and methodology descriptor
